call.text: The authors report that the 2‑stage H‑Net configuration matched to GPT‑3 Large achieves an average zero‑shot accuracy of 55.5 % [HNET:T2:r10]. The authors’ Transformer model matched to GPT‑3 Large attains an average zero‑shot accuracy of 53.3 % [HNET:T2:r01]. The authors note that the 2‑stage H‑Net’s average accuracy matches that of the larger Transformer configuration matched to GPT‑3 XL, which also has an average zero‑shot accuracy of 55.5 % [HNET:T2:r11].
